build_retinanet_model: build a RetinaNet object detection model from a detectron2 config with backbone and head
run_retinanet_inference: run RetinaNet inference on a batch of images to get bounding box predictions and scores
compute_retinanet_losses: compute focal loss and box regression loss for RetinaNet training with anchor labels
label_retinanet_anchors: label RetinaNet anchors by matching them with ground truth instances using IoU
create_retinanet_head: create a RetinaNetHead module with classification and box regression subnets for object detection
